output.summary: An annual climbing vetch native to Turkey and Malta, and also native in Greece. It has purple-and-white flowers, branched leaf tendrils and hairy seed pods. It is not cultivated for human consumption, and its seeds contain high levels of vicine, which causes favism in susceptible people.
